title: Looming motion captures visual attention fastest
statement:
Motion that simulates an object approaching the viewer (looming) captures visual attention significantly faster and more reliably than receding or lateral motion.

Options:
- High Priority Attention: Scale up from 0.8x to 1.0x (Looming) (fits: critical errors, urgent alerts)
- Standard Introduction: Lateral slide-in (fits: toast messages, side drawers)
- Dismissal / Exit: Scale down from 1.0x to 0.8x (Receding) (fits: closing modals, deleting items)
appliesWhen: Applies to: notifications, error states, modals. Audience: general.

source.title: Moving and looming stimuli capture attention
source.authors: Steven L. Franconeri; Daniel J. Simons
